headline: South Asia: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
script:
Good evening. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- South Asia: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate.
- Asia: US strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island after drones target Bahrain.
- Western Russia: Pentagon's deputy chief condemns Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russia, saying they "incur pain on Russian population".

Full breakdown follows.

NORTH AMERICA
United States - bottom line: She reported her sexual assault. The Marine Corps kicked her out..
- Military Times, 9 hours ago: She reported her sexual assault. The Marine Corps kicked her out..
Over the past five years, at least 30 Marines were discharged after reporting they were sexually assaulted, according to records obtained by The War Horse.
- Military Times, 10 hours ago: VA wants to stop charging premiums on 16,000 WWII-era veteran life insurance policies.
The VA says it can stop charging premiums to thousands of veterans who hold a World War II-era life insurance policy.
The Caribbean - bottom line: Llewellyn: Don’t let status go to your head - Former DPP warns against ego in public service.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 20 hours ago: Llewellyn: Don’t let status go to your head - Former DPP warns against ego in public service.
Former Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP) Paula Llewellyn has condemned the arrogance of some Jamaican public officials who become so blinded by their status that they forget their duty to serve. “Too often in Jamaica, too often perhaps even in the Caribbean, you have a situation where people, dressed in brief authority, you get a position, and you levitate up into the sky and forget that as a public servant, you are serving the public,” she said.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 20 hours ago: Buyers, beware! - Jamaicans urged to seek professional advice before buying properties.
WESTERN BUREAU: Prospective property buyers are being urged to seek professional advice and conduct thorough due diligence before committing to real estate transactions as mistakes can result in significant financial losses. The advice came from real estate attorney Debra-Ann Matthews of Matthews & Walker Attorneys-at-Law and real estate broker Kenneth Beckles of K.B. Real Estate Co Ltd, who were panellists discussing ‘Buying Property in Jamaica: Real Estate, Construction & Investment’ at the Throp X Conference.
Central America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

WASHINGTON: Pakistan on Tuesday strongly condemned Israel’s continued attacks and incursions into Syrian territory, calling for an immediate end to the violations, withdrawal from occupied areas and full compliance with the 1974 Disengagement Agreement and relevant UN Security Council resolutions. “The occupied Golan is Syrian territory under international law,” Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, told the Security Council.

Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir underscored the importance of sustained engagement, mutual trust and close coordination between the two countries to promote regional peace and stability during a meeting with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, the military’s media wing said on Tuesday. According to a statement issued by the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), matters of mutual interest, regional security dynamics and evolving geopolitical developments were also discussed between the two.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 19 hours ago: Trump is not going to let Iran conflict become a 'forever war', asserts Vance.
US Vice President JD Vance said on Monday that President Donald Trump will not allow the ongoing war on Iran to turn into a prolonged military commitment, rejecting calls for an extended US presence and insisting that the administration remains committed to avoiding another “forever war”. In an interview with Fox News, Vance said there was no disagreement between him and Trump over the direction of the conflict, emphasising that the president intends to bring the war to an end rather than allow it to become a long-term engagement.
